# Getting help

- **Using the site or API:** Check the [quickstart](../README.md#quickstart) and [technical reference](../docs/wiki/07-technical-reference.md), then open a [bug report](https://github.com/aartisr/urban-heat-democratization/issues/new/choose) with a reproducible example.
- **Research interpretation or local data:** Read the [evidence guide](../docs/wiki/04-evidence-and-responsible-use.md) and open a data or evidence issue. Do not include personal or sensitive location data.
- **Ideas and collaboration:** Use the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and an issue.
- **Security:** Follow the [private security policy](SECURITY.md).
- **Conduct:** Follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

This is a public-interest research project, not an emergency service. If you are facing immediate heat-related danger, use local emergency or public-health services.
